title: Plugin data through the relay
switchLabel: Let plugins use a server's relay
switchText: Plugins you allow can send larger data (game moves, drawings) faster through the server community's relay. End-to-end encrypted: the relay can't read it. Without a relay they fall back to the slower Mumble connection.
officialNone: Official · doesn't ask for relay data
noPlugins: No plugin asks for relay data.

sounds.title: Plugin sounds
sounds.text: Short sounds that come with plugins. Volume and mute apply to all plugins.
